Blend values (M$/yr): C3mix 73, C4mix 186, C5mix 618, C6parmix 1180, C6naphmix 396, nC7 332, nC8 358, nC9 103. Pure total 3615 but needs 16 sharp cuts — far too costly at this cost level.

Key tradeoff: at this cost level each column costs 30-450M/yr, so I need each column to yield >100M revenue, requiring fairly sharp separation (high reflux + many stages). My prior cascades spread too thin with too many mediocre columns.

With 9 solves left there is little I can safely build; any 1-2 column attempt is likely to leak and score negative. Protecting 0.000 is rational. If I experiment, do ONE wide-gap easy split (C4-/C5+ or C5mix/C6+) with high reflux and verify a single blend qualifies before adding more.
